scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run clean && npm run extension:sync && npm run build:sidepanel && npm run build:background && npm run build:cli && npm run build:tui && npm run build:workspace-agent && npm run build:workspace-transfer && npm run build:runner && npm run build:proxy && npm run build:debug-server && npm run build:package
scripts.build:proxy: mkdir -p dist/allowlist-proxy && cp docker/allowlist-proxy/Dockerfile dist/allowlist-proxy/Dockerfile && esbuild src/node/allowlist-proxy-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/allowlist-proxy/allowlist-proxy.cjs
scripts.clean: rm -rf extension/js/sidepanel extension/js/background && mkdir -p extension/js/sidepanel extension/js/background
scripts.workspace:export: npm run build:workspace-transfer && node dist/tinyai-workspace-transfer.cjs export
scripts.workspace:import: npm run build:workspace-transfer && node dist/tinyai-workspace-transfer.cjs import
scripts.test:soak:equivalent: TINYAI_SOAK=1 TINYAI_SOAK_CYCLES=28800 TINYAI_SOAK_INTERVAL_MS=10 TINYAI_SOAK_DURATION_MS=600000 vitest run tests/soak/production.test.ts
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:core && npm run check:boundaries && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && TINYAI_E2E_CHROME=cft vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.mts
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build && TINYAI_E2E_CHROME=cft TINYAI_E2E_HEADED=1 vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.mts
scripts.test:e2e:stable: npm run build && TINYAI_E2E_CHROME=stable vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.mts
scripts.test:e2e:auto: npm run build && TINYAI_E2E_CHROME=auto vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.mts
scripts.check: npm run requirements:check && npm run adr:check && npm run decisions:check && npm run extension:check && npm run check:ui && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:core && npm run check:boundaries && npm test && npm run build
